Type of Emails: VM, REKKI, JELLY, MARKETMAN, PROCURE WIZARD
External Reference Format: *type of email* *time received, use military time* *include what Day (SUN/MON/TUE/WED/THU/FRI) if incase preorder*
Sample for VMs: GEN 20:10 (this is required by the supplier) (GEN for General email w/c is the VM)
NON VMs Format: *Order number from the email* *type of non VM* *time received*
Sample Non VMs Format: 7488645 REKKI 21:10 ; 250214-73475491 JELLY 21:00
*If a cx mentions a PO number (their own PO number), include it in the External Reference back at the last part and/or in the Additional Notes (usually from Durrants Farm, Wiston House, and Hallmark Care Homes Ltd)
